posts.headline: Eight straight editions and One Nut Barner STILL hasn't said a word — Put it in Ra's kickoff to real Week 1 games with a 20-8 record and 1.5 average finish and zero rings to show for it.
posts.detail: The silence is now longer than the record itself deserves credit for — this league is watching the most disrespected résumé in Busters Anonymous history stay mute as actual games are about to matter.

posts.headline: The draft's locked, Week 1 is here, and Big Head has officially run out of days to explain how a title banner hangs over a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World rebranded nothing and changed nothing on paper — a contender tier with a losing record is about to get tested by games that actually count, not just excuses.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finally gets real games to play, and the untalented tenth enters with the single worst résumé in the league on the line.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and dead-last 12th-place finish doesn't get erased by a locked roster — Week 1 is Chauncey's first real chance in this recap to prove the nickname wrong, and history says don't hold your breath.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT enters live Week 1 still answering for the sin of drafting a DEFENSIVE player first overall, and this league's patience for the Ultimate Light Skin is thinner than his 13-14-1 career mark.
posts.detail: Eli can preach Bible or Belt all he wants, but a 5.5 average finish says the football gods haven't been listening — real games start now and the plagues are due.

posts.headline: After nine straight editions of silence, Thicks finally has to defend the #FreeMaxx crown with actual games on the board, not just a ring from last year.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish have been hiding behind hardware for two seasons — Week 1 kicks off the only measuring stick that's ever mattered, and the excuses are officially out of runway.
